summary: The US-Iran ceasefire extension lifted stocks to record highs while dragging gold sharply lower as safe-haven demand evaporated. Oil's retreat eased inflation fears and compressed bond yields, explaining bonds' week-long recovery. Friday's May jobs report now takes center stage as the key read on Fed policy direction.
tweet: US-Iran ceasefire extension sent stocks to records and crushed gold's safe-haven bid. Now all eyes shift to Friday's May jobs report for the next Fed signal.
